gloss_en: davar (דָּבָר) — 'word/thing/matter'; the noun for speech/utterance or a thing/matter, used homiletically as bechinat yirah (fear, LM1:15, 'az nidberu yirei H'') and bechinat Malkhut (LM1:4, 'kol davar asher yavo va'esh')

outliers.actual_gloss_en: dabbar — leader/ruler/spokesman of a generation ('dabbar echad le-dor', Sanhedrin 8a)
outliers.reason: Vocalized דַּבָּר with dagesh — a distinct noun meaning leader (לשון מנהיג ומושל), explicitly glossed so in the text; homograph of דָּבָר 'word/thing'

outliers.actual_gloss_en: dabbar — leader/ruler/spokesman of a generation ('dabbar echad le-dor', Sanhedrin 8a)
outliers.reason: Same citation as occ:1726: דַּבָּר = manhig u-moshel (leader and ruler), not davar 'word/thing'; a different word sharing the same consonants
